summary: R05/T05 follow-up: make production read_file honor its exact selected-range contract up to the existing hard output cap, reuse verified-current Evidence without unnecessary physical rereads, and expose deterministic continuation ranges when that hard cap is exceeded, without adding semantic authority.

components.owning_subsystem: Evidence projection, exact file-range delivery, immutable snapshot continuity and verified-current source reuse
components.disposition: ADMIT as a mechanical exact-byte/range/version/reuse contract that removes unnecessary rereads. It does not choose which fields matter, infer task relevance, edit source content or decide task completion.
evidence: Production factory explicitly opts read_file exact selected-range projection into the existing tool_max_output_chars hard cap; manual and frozen Evidence harnesses retain the historical generic projection unless they opt in.

An inventory regression places code_fingerprints, git and adjudication in the middle and verifies an in-budget snapshot range exposes all requested keys while the immutable artifact baseline preserves the complete original bytes.
A verified-current approximately 10KB read_file Evidence observation is reused on the second logical read with source_execution_performed=false, one physical source execution and one ledger capture.

When the real hard cap is exceeded, read_file exposes one contiguous prefix plus recovery_ref, text_char visible/omitted ranges, next_start and source_version; prefix plus hydration from next_start reassembles the captured observation byte-for-byte with no gap or overlap.

The folded tool receipt preserves evidence_ref, artifact_ref/path/sha256, source-line coverage and recovery_tool=read_evidence, so recovery can resume from the selected work object instead of replaying an old execute_command receipt to rediscover the path.
All test_evidence*.py plus tool-working-set projection passed, followed by scripts/ci_gate.sh with whole-tree Ruff, env-pin, Pyright, tier0 and xdist pytest all green.
components.verification_level: R05/T05 focused deterministic regression + full Evidence-family/working-set regression + whole-tree CI + staged and committed-state A.5/security qualification
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Program logic preserves exact requested bytes, ranges, source version/ref/currentness, immutable snapshot identity and physical reuse facts only. The model chooses keys/ranges, decides semantic importance and whether more evidence is needed, performs edits and decides completion.
components.rollback_route: Revert this follow-up commit. Production read_file then returns to the generic Evidence projection budget; historical/manual Evidence harness defaults remain unchanged.
